idea-plugin.name: Cmd Widgets
idea-plugin.description:
Display shell command output as independent widgets in your IDE status bar. Track Git branches, disk space, Kubernetes contexts, or any other value available from a command. Percentage output automatically displays a progress bar.

  • Configure global widgets with individual refresh intervals and working directories.
  • Run commands on the frontend or backend host, including in remote development.
  • Test commands before saving and inspect output, errors, and execution details.
  • Retain the last successful value and mark it as stale after a failure.

Open Settings / Preferences > Tools > Cmd Widget to create your first widget. Command execution supports macOS, Linux, and Windows hosts. Commands run with your user permissions; configure only commands you trust.

Source code and documentation | Report an issue | MIT License
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0 — Initial release

  • Independent command widgets with text and automatic percentage progress bars.
  • Global settings, per-project results, refresh intervals, and working directories.
  • Frontend and backend execution with remote development support.
  • Explicit command testing, execution diagnostics, and stale-value indicators.
  • Bounded output capture, timeouts, and cancellation on macOS, Linux, and Windows.
